remarks: Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom ranch, nestled on a quiet dead-end street. Offering comfortable one-floor living and a full dry basement, it has plenty of possibilities. This home is a wonderful opportunity for those looking to make a home their own. The Well-Appointed Kitchen and Bright Dining Area add to the charm. It is conveniently located for commuting, shopping and entertainment. Mechanical updates include Furnace and AC installed in 2021, Extensive Plumbing Improvements with Transferable Warranty from Mr. Plumber recently completed including installation of a Sump Pump with Battery Back-Up. The yard is partially fenced and the Open Porch on the front is a great place for your morning coffee or evening relaxation. The Enclosed Sunroom makes the outside available, even when Mother Nature doesn't cooperate. The 2025 Stove and Dishwasher are included as is the 2026 Microwave and the Refrigerator. Even the Washer and Dryer are included for added convenience. This freshly painted home is Move-In Ready and just waiting for its next chapter! Showings start immediately - Offer review will begin on 10/25 at 6PM.
